basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur) Project Research Scientist Notification 2026 has been released on 24 July 2026 on the official website of All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur). A total of 2 vacancies have been announced through the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist Recruitment 2026.

qualification.details: Project Research Scientist-II (Medical): MBBS / BVSc / BDS with three years' experience OR MBBS / BVSc / BDS with MPH / PhD OR MBBS / BVSc / BDS + Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment is scheduled to be held on 11 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) and Project Research Scientist-I at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: For Project Research Scientist-I, candidates need a First Class Postgraduate Degree in specified fields or a Second Class Postgraduate Degree with Ph.D. in the same disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) and Project Research Scientist-I positions is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Research Scientist-II (Medical)?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) is ₹96,000 per month, which includes a basic pay of ₹80,000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions at AIIMS Jodhpur will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the AIIMS Jodhpur office. The exact address and reporting time will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the job type for these positions is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the project requirements.
